news.text: #Juve, Eyes On #VarelaThe striker costs 35 million and is being tracked by 4 English clubs.Inquiry made for #Monza's Portuguese, the Serie A top scorer with nine goals. #Massara has made a move, but it is an obstacle course: #Tottenham and #Liverpool are first in line. The ex #Benfica talent is also liked by #Brentford and #Sunderland.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#CONTE'S STORM HITS #JUVEAntonio shakes up the bianconero world: "I know I left something behind, sooner or later the circle will have to close." The manager of the three scudetti: "I don't know if it will be in one, ten or fifteen years, but it will happen. Twice already I could have returned, then they chose #Sarri and #Motta". Meanwhile #Carnevali reassures: "UEFA limits the mercato, but we must give satisfaction to our fans". [Front Page TuttoSport]

🤵‍♂️🗣 Giorgio #Chiellini at the inaugural event of 'Juventus Official Fan Club Unione Europea':#JUVENTUS AT THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT - "Personally, it is already extremely exciting to be at the European Parliament. I had never been here before and it is always exciting to see what happens outside of Italy and how people try to change and fix the world. Today is a day where we are here for the inauguration of the Olimpia Italiana together with the European Union. It always makes a certain impression, we are happy to be here and, starting today, we will be a small stepping stone in building a relationship".ON WHETHER HE SEES THE LIGHT OF #JUVENTUS'S REBIRTH - "You can always see the light, some

Therefore, we are all working very hard on this. And as our CEO said, we are working along this path and we are truly confident that this can happen".[@juventusinsidernews]

In case he has to pull out, there would be 3 solutions:1️⃣ One possibility could be #Gatti at right-back, even though he isn't strictly a full-back and his characteristics are different;2️⃣ Another solution would be to play with a back three, with #McKennie on the right and either #Cabal or #Cambiaso on the left;3️⃣ The third option would be to have #Cambiaso on one side - who still trained separately - and #Cabal on the other, with one of the two potentially adapted to play on the right."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
